request.system_message:
You abstract all predicate definitions in one semantic cluster into exactly one reusable, mechanism-level predicate conforming to predicate-definition/v2.

Read every member's complete definition, ordered parameters, assertion conditions, and exclusion conditions. Identify the shared underlying behavioral mechanism. Generalize concrete tasks, tools, files, services, and scenarios while retaining the logical constraints needed by that mechanism. Prefer a genuinely shared mechanism over similar vocabulary or a common topic. For example, specific action-result checks can generalize to verification of action effects; feedback-driven adjustments can generalize to revision of actions in response to feedback; concrete conflict-handling operations can generalize to conflict identification and resolution.

Cover the common semantics of the members with a concrete, observable, decidable mechanism. Preserve necessary behavioral direction and causal relationships; distinguish the roles of reasoning, action, and observation; retain important differences between attempting an effect and successfully achieving it; retain essential preconditions, assertion conditions, and exclusions with real distinguishing value. Avoid task-specific restrictions, vacuous generalizations, and mechanisms unsupported by the source members. This is Predicate Abstraction / Generalization: it may generalize multiple specific behaviors and does not require the bidirectional logical equivalence used by Registry Revision MERGE.

All members belong to the same arity group. The generated predicate MUST have exactly the cluster arity: len(parameters) == cluster.arity. Allowed parameter types are reasoning, action, observation, reasoning[], action[], observation[]. A homogeneous collection parameter counts as one argument. Preserve interpretable semantic roles and ordered argument relationships. You may rename parameters to express the common mechanism. Parameter names must be distinct lower_snake_case identifiers.

Always generate exactly one final predicate, including for singleton clusters and clusters with internal differences. For differing members, find the most reasonable common mechanism covering the group and preserve meaningful distinguishing conditions as far as possible. Never declare the members incompatible or impossible to merge. Never suggest splitting the cluster, deleting members, human handling, or multiple candidates. Never return incompatible, skip, failed, rejected, null, an empty predicate, or any status/reason wrapper. Do not add evaluation scores or explanations.

Return exactly one JSON object containing exactly these five fields:
{
  "name": "UPPER_SNAKE_CASE_NAME",
  "definition": "Complete, precise semantic definition.",
  "parameters": [
    {
      "name": "parameter_name",
      "type": "reasoning",
      "description": "Precise ordered argument role."
    }
  ],
  "assertion_conditions": ["Explicit observable condition."],
  "exclusion_conditions": ["Distinguishing exclusion condition."]
}
The example illustrates structure only; the actual ordered parameter count must equal the input cluster arity. The predicate name must be UPPER_SNAKE_CASE and must not conflict with any previously generated predicate name. Definition and parameter descriptions must be complete nonempty strings. Parameters must be a nonempty ordered typed array; each parameter must contain exactly name, type, description. Assertion conditions must contain at least one explicit nonempty condition. Exclusion conditions may be an empty array. Neither condition list may contain duplicates. Use English for all text. Output JSON only, with no Markdown or additional text.

  {

    "parameters": [
      {
        "name": "reasoning",
        "type": "reasoning",
        "description": "The agent text listing the conditions the final environment must satisfy."

    "name": "ASSESSES_ROBUSTNESS_ACROSS_HYPOTHETICAL_SCENARIOS",
    "definition": "The reasoning considers two or more distinct hypothetical courses of behavior that an external actor, procedure, or environment might exhibit, and selects the candidate state, configuration, or action that remains valid or correct across all of the considered hypotheses.",
    "parameters": [

        "name": "reasoning",
        "type": "reasoning",
        "description": "The agent text enumerating alternative hypothetical scenarios and comparing the validity of candidate states or actions across them."
      }

    "assertion_conditions": [
      "The reasoning describes at least two distinct hypothetical scenarios, procedures, or behaviors that an external actor or environment might follow.",
      "The reasoning evaluates which candidate state, configuration, or action remains valid under those enumerated scenarios.",

    "exclusion_conditions": [
      "The reasoning considers only a single expected scenario or line of behavior.",
      "The reasoning enumerates scenarios without drawing any comparative conclusion about which candidate state or action to adopt.",

message.reasoning_content:
We need answer one JSON only. Need abstract cluster unary-003 two members. Need find common mechanism. Both are about reasoning enumerating multiple possible requirements/scenarios and evaluating candidate based on satisfying conditions across them. Member1: enumerate required end-state checkable conditions, not actions. Member2: enumerate hypothetical scenarios and select robust candidate valid across scenarios. Common underlying behavioral mechanism: reasoning enumerates multiple distinct alternatives/conditions (possible scenarios or required state properties) and evaluates/selects a candidate (configuration/action/state) by whether it satisfies/remains valid under all enumerated considerations. Need generalize concrete tasks. Arity 1 reasoning parameter.

Need choose name unique not conflict. Maybe ENUMERATES_AND_EVALUATES_CANDIDATE_AGAINST_MULTIPLE_CONSTRAINTS_OR_SCENARIOS? UPPER_SNAKE. Need exactly one parameter reasoning.

Need definition precise, observable, decidable. It should cover both: reasoning enumerates multiple distinct checkable conditions or hypothetical scenarios and uses them to evaluate/select a candidate state/action/configuration that satisfies all or most. Preserve differences as far possible: conditions may be required end-state invariants or hypothetical external behaviors; candidate can be final environment state or action/config. Need assertion conditions: reasoning lists at least two distinct conditions/scenarios that candidate must satisfy or remain valid under; items are phrased as checkable properties or hypothetical behaviors rather than mere steps; reasoning evaluates candidate against enumerated items and selects/favors one satisfying all/most. Exclusion: single condition/scenario; only actions sequence no resulting conditions; enumerates without comparative conclusion; rival explanations for observed situation? This is meaningful exclusion from member2. But common mechanism covers scenario/condition enumeration. Need avoid too broad? It should be mechanism-level.

Maybe name: EVALUATES_CANDIDATE_AGAINST_ENUMERATED_CONSTRAINTS_OR_SCENARIOS. That's long but okay UPPER_SNAKE. Does not conflict. Parameter name maybe "reasoning". Definition: "The reasoning enumerates two or more distinct checkable conditions or hypothetical scenarios and evaluates candidate states, configurations, or actions for satisfying/remaining valid under all or most of the enumerated items; the enumerated items specify required end-state invariants or possible external behaviors rather than an action sequence, and the reasoning selects or favors the candidate that best satisfies them."

Need exactly fields. Assertion conditions list at least one. Exclusions. Ensure no duplicates. Output JSON only. Need not include explanations.

Let's craft with exact five fields.

Potential issue: "candidate states, configurations, or actions" fits both. Need "multiple" maybe "at least two". Assertion:
- reasoning explicitly enumerates at least two distinct checkable conditions that a candidate must satisfy or hypothetical scenarios/behaviors under which candidate must remain valid.
- enumerated items are expressed as verifiable properties of resulting state or as possible external behaviors, not merely a sequence of steps to perform.
- reasoning compares/favors/selects candidate state/config/action based on satisfaction/validity across enumerated items, preferably all considered.
Exclusions:
- only one condition/scenario.
- describes action sequence without stating resulting conditions or possible behaviors.
- enumerates items without drawing conclusion about candidate.
- enumerated items are rival explanations for observed situation rather than requirements/hypothetical future behaviors (maybe preserve).
- candidate alternatives differ only incidential no robustness trade-off? Maybe include as distinguishing but not over restrict. We can include.

Need "previously generated predicate names" no conflict. Name unique.

Let's ensure all conditions explicit observable decidable. Use "reasoning text" maybe.

Return JSON only.

parsed_response.name: EVALUATES_CANDIDATE_AGAINST_ENUMERATED_CONSTRAINTS_OR_SCENARIOS
parsed_response.definition: The reasoning enumerates two or more distinct checkable conditions that a delivered result must satisfy or hypothetical scenarios/courses of behavior under which a candidate must remain valid, then evaluates candidate states, configurations, or actions against those enumerated items and selects or favors the candidate that satisfies all, or the greatest number, of them. The enumerated items concern verifiable properties of a resulting state or possible external behaviors, rather than merely a sequence of steps to execute.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text enumerating multiple required end-state conditions or hypothetical scenarios and evaluating, selecting, or favoring a candidate state, configuration, or action based on its validity across those enumerated items.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning explicitly enumerates at least two distinct checkable conditions that a candidate must satisfy or hypothetical scenarios or external behaviors under which a candidate must remain valid.
The enumerated items are expressed as verifiable properties of a resulting state or as possible external procedures or behaviors, rather than as an action sequence alone.
The reasoning compares, selects, or favors a candidate state, configuration, or action according to whether it satisfies all, or the greatest number, of the enumerated conditions or scenarios.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning considers only a single expected condition or scenario, with no enumeration of multiple required properties or hypothetical behaviors.
The reasoning describes a sequence of actions to execute without stating the resulting state conditions or the possible external behaviors under which a candidate must remain valid.
The reasoning enumerates conditions or scenarios without drawing any comparative conclusion about which candidate state, configuration, or action to adopt.
The enumerated items are rival explanations for an already observed situation rather than requirements for a resulting state or hypothetical future behaviors to withstand.
